title: The Anti-Boring Meal Prep System | Jerk Chicken
description:
meal prep works better when you stop forcing yourself to eat the same leftovers all week.

same protein. different meals.

🌶️ jerk chicken (freezer prep)
5 servings — 296 cal / 40P / 11F / 9C

ingredients:
• 1kg boneless skinless chicken thighs
• 3 green onions
• 1 shallot
• 1–2 scotch bonnets
• 1” ginger
• 3 cloves garlic
• 2 tbsp dried thyme
• 1 tbsp allspice
• ½ tsp nutmeg
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp brown sugar
• ½ tbsp salt
• ½ tbsp black pepper
• 1 tbsp EVOO
• ½ tbsp vinegar
• juice of ½ lime
• juice of ¼ orange
• 1 tbsp water

blend → portion → marinate → freeze
